Class EnemyFactory

java.lang.Object
main.factory.baseFactories.EnemyFactory
public class EnemyFactory extends Object
Factory class for creating enemy characters. Provides methods to create enemies by ID, name, danger level, or randomly. Contains 50 predefined enemies with various danger levels and stats.
